purpose: Determine how the theory-guided knowledge-construction components can be causally evaluated without treating one final benchmark table as evidence for every mechanism.

method_state.knowledge_unit: A content-addressed typed skill with scope, extractor, transformation, semantic obligation, resource obligation and provenance.
method_state.construction_principle: Verified structural risk minimization over a frozen candidate language: minimize held-out endpoint risk plus label-independent description cost subject to semantic, resource and promotion constraints.
method_state.deployment_principle: Exactly-one public-only routing with exact fallback when zero or multiple guards match.
method_state.claim_boundary: The theory constrains what may be admitted and deployed; it does not by itself prove that an LLM proposer discovers useful skills or that any component improves benchmark accuracy.

identifiability_finding.reason: Semantic verification, resource admission and complexity control act on proposal or library selection, whereas selective routing acts on deployment envelopes. These components have different interventions, units and observable failure modes.
required_layers: envelope-level routing under ambiguity or shift

components.intervention: Remove the semantic proof obligation while retaining the immutable parser, compiler, exact resource cap and endpoint scorer.
components.unit: A frozen candidate proposal from one common candidate pool.
primary_estimands: difference in collateral-change or regression rate
difference in held-out endpoint accuracy after promotion
components.safe_execution: Candidates rejected by the full verifier are scored in a sealed offline evaluator; they are never deployed.
components.current_evidence: The failed typed count proposer shows that semantic success alone is insufficient, but it is not a matched no-verifier ablation.

components.intervention: Remove the method's predictive resource admission decision while retaining a non-removable evaluator hard cap.
components.unit: A frozen candidate proposal from the same common candidate pool.
primary_estimands: difference in resource rejection and unavailable mass
components.safe_execution: A cap hit is an incorrect endpoint outcome; unrestricted execution is prohibited.
components.current_evidence: The typed count proposer passes 20,977 semantic assignments and fails exact resource admission, demonstrating a mechanism-level counterexample but not an average causal effect.

components.intervention: Set the prespecified description-length coefficient to zero while holding the candidate pool, hard obligations, producer budget and promotion data fixed.
components.unit: One independent library-selection episode or lineage-separated benchmark group, not one candidate from an adaptively shared parent.
primary_estimands: difference in selected serialized library length
difference in confirmation endpoint accuracy at equal construction budget
components.safe_execution: Both selected libraries must satisfy the same semantic and resource obligations before endpoint evaluation.
components.current_evidence: The prefix-code bound justifies the design under its assumptions; current authored libraries do not isolate an empirical complexity effect.

components.intervention: Replace exactly-one routing and fallback with a prespecified forced-family or relaxed-guard policy while retaining the same skills and outer safety cap.
components.unit: One frozen public envelope from a prespecified ambiguity, paraphrase, schema-shift or new-family cohort.
primary_estimands: difference in ambiguity and fallback rate
difference in routed corrections and regressions
components.safe_execution: All arms retain immutable compiler and evaluator caps; forced unsafe candidates are scored offline only.
components.current_evidence: The 2,985-record mixed confirmation proves exact preservation on known envelopes. It has no routing contrast and cannot identify the value of selective routing under shift.

reference_rows_not_component_ablations.role: Tests whether evolution adds value beyond a fixed expert library.
End-to-end treatment against which claim-critical interventions are paired.

prospective_design_requirements.common_candidate_pool: Every construction ablation receives the same content-addressed proposals or the same randomized producer draws, with identical model, public evidence, grammar, request and token ceilings, stopping rule and evaluator.
prospective_design_requirements.frozen_selection_rule: Candidate code length, verifier version, resource limits, promotion endpoint and tie breaking are fixed before held-out outcomes are opened.
prospective_design_requirements.routing_shift_cohort: Routing is evaluated on a separate prespecified envelope cohort containing zero-match, exactly-one-match and multiple-match opportunities; known family identities alone are insufficient.
prospective_design_requirements.outer_safety_invariant: No ablation may remove the evaluator's hard parser, memory, time, variable, row, nonzero or byte caps.
prospective_design_requirements.denominator_rule: Rejected, abstained, ambiguous, unsupported, hard-cap and terminal failures remain in the prespecified denominator.
prospective_design_requirements.causal_language_rule: A component may be called beneficial only for its prespecified contrast and unit. Failure of a single candidate cannot establish necessity, and success of the full system cannot allocate credit among components.

multiplicity_and_power.familywise_rule: Holm correction at familywise alpha 0.05; alpha 0.0125 is the conservative planning value for each of four contrasts.
multiplicity_and_power.n38_test: One-sided exact conditional McNemar/sign test integrated over D~Binomial(38,r).
multiplicity_and_power.interpretation: The 38-record fresh cohort can expose large component failures and provide descriptive paired mechanisms, but it is underpowered for four moderate confirmatory effects. Proposal/library and routing cohorts must be sized for their own units, and larger independent endpoint cohorts are required for strong causal component claims.

decision.permitted_current_claim: The knowledge library and its construction process admit a coherent theory-to-mechanism mapping with separately identifiable acquisition, admission, selection and routing layers.
prohibited_current_claims: All four components are causally necessary.
The existing 38-record cohort is adequately powered for four moderate component effects.
Known-envelope mixed routing proves robustness under distribution shift.
A failed resource gate estimates the average benefit of resource admission.
The Occam bound proves that the current complexity controller improves empirical accuracy.
